values.task: Add `parseRanges(text, pageCount)` in a new file, src/parse-ranges.mjs: it reads what a person typed into the print dialog's page box, such as "1-3,5" or "7", and returns the page numbers to print as an array. Pages are numbered from 1 to `pageCount`; parts are separated by commas, and a part is one page or a range written first-last. A `text` that is not a string, or a `pageCount` that is not a positive integer, throws a TypeError; a text that cannot be read as pages of this document throws a RangeError. Tests go in tests/parse-ranges.test.mjs.
